sections.introduction_on_chitrakadi_vati:
Chitrakadi Vati is Ayurvedic medicine which is available in the tablet form. It is quite good to improve the digestion power of the body. Use of this medicine is very useful to treat problems like anorexia and indigestion. This Ayurvedic medicine has the digestive and detoxifying properties. It aids in the digestion and removes the accumulated toxins in the body. 
 Chitrakadi Vati balances the tridoshas – vata, pitta dosha and balances kapha in body. 
 Chitrakadi Vati Ingredients 
 10 g fine powder of each of:- 

 Chitraka – Plumbago zeylanica 
 Pippalimool – Long pepper root Piper longum 
 Yava Kshara – Kshara of Barley – Hordeum vulgare 
 Swarjika Kshara 
 Sauvarchala Lavana – Sochal salt 
 Saindhava Lavana – Rock salt 
 Vida Lavana – Vida salt 
 Samudra Lavana – Common salt, 
 Audbhida Lavana 
 Shunti – Ginger Rhizome – Zingiber officinale 
 Maricha – Black pepper – Piper nigrum 
 Pippali – Long pepper fruit – Piper longum 
 Hingu – Asafoetida – Ferula assa-foetida 
 Ajamoda – Ajowan (fruit) – Trachyspermum roxburghianum 
 Chavya – Java Long Pepper – Piper chaba 
 Matulunga Swarasa – Lemon juice or Dadima rasa – Pomegranate juice – Quantity Sufficient. 

 Method of Preparation 
 The fine powder of the above-mentioned ingredient is triturated with lemon juice or pomegranate juice and a paste is prepared. Further it is rolled into tablet form, dried and preserved.
sections.dosage: (500 mg tablet) Take one – two tablets, once or twice in a day before or after food or as directed by an Ayurvedic doctor.
sections.indications:
Anorexia 
 Indigestion 
 Irritable bowel syndrome 
 Abdominal gas 
 Malabsorption 
 Obesity 
 Diarrhea with mucus discharge.
sections.side_effects:
Overdose may result in the slight burning sensation in abdomen, heartburn, , hyperacidity and gastritis. 
 Keep out of reach and sight of children. 
 Store in a cool dry place. 

 Caution – People with high BP should take this medicine only under medical care, as it contains salt as an ingredient. 

 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.

fullContent:
Chitrakadi Vati – Uses, Benefits, Indications and Dosage 
 Reference: Charaka Samhita Chikitsa Sthana 15/96-97 
 Introduction on Chitrakadi Vati 
 Chitrakadi Vati is Ayurvedic medicine which is available in the tablet form. It is quite good to improve the digestion power of the body. Use of this medicine is very useful to treat problems like anorexia and indigestion. This Ayurvedic medicine has the digestive and detoxifying properties. It aids in the digestion and removes the accumulated toxins in the body. 
 Chitrakadi Vati balances the tridoshas – vata, pitta dosha and balances kapha in body. 
 Chitrakadi Vati Ingredients 
 10 g fine powder of each of:- 
 
 Chitraka – Plumbago zeylanica 
 Pippalimool – Long pepper root Piper longum 
 Yava Kshara – Kshara of Barley – Hordeum vulgare 
 Swarjika Kshara 
 Sauvarchala Lavana – Sochal salt 
 Saindhava Lavana – Rock salt 
 Vida Lavana – Vida salt 
 Samudra Lavana – Common salt, 
 Audbhida Lavana 
 Shunti – Ginger Rhizome – Zingiber officinale 
 Maricha – Black pepper – Piper nigrum 
 Pippali – Long pepper fruit – Piper longum 
 Hingu – Asafoetida – Ferula assa-foetida 
 Ajamoda – Ajowan (fruit) – Trachyspermum roxburghianum 
 Chavya – Java Long Pepper – Piper chaba 
 Matulunga Swarasa – Lemon juice or Dadima rasa – Pomegranate juice – Quantity Sufficient. 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 The fine powder of the above-mentioned ingredient is triturated with lemon juice or pomegranate juice and a paste is prepared. Further it is rolled into tablet form, dried and preserved. 
 Dosage 
 (500 mg tablet) Take one – two tablets, once or twice in a day before or after food or as directed by an Ayurvedic doctor. 
 Indications 
 
 Anorexia 
 Indigestion 
 Irritable bowel syndrome 
 Abdominal gas 
 Malabsorption 
 Obesity 
 Diarrhea with mucus discharge. 
 
 Side Effects 
 
 Overdose may result in the slight burning sensation in abdomen, heartburn, , hyperacidity and gastritis. 
 Keep out of reach and sight of children. 
 Store in a cool dry place. 
 
 Caution – People with high BP should take this medicine only under medical care, as it contains salt as an ingredient. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
